mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction signal Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% year-over-year), a decline in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary easing that boosts equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month average industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0 (3-month average), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE increases, or interaction signal Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 550.0 thousand units in a 3-month average indicates housing sector weakness that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 550.0 (3-month average), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
